name: Download Statistics
description: Logs file download statistics for your site.
project_description: Download Statistics extends the idea of core's Statistics module to files: it counts how many times each managed file is downloaded, giving you a total count, a daily count, the timestamp of the most recent download and the UID of the last downloader. It works only for files served through Drupal (the private file system): when counting is enabled, a route subscriber (FileDownloadAlterRouteSubscriber) swaps the controllers for the core system.files and system.private_file_download routes to DownloadStatisticsFileController, which records a download (via a MERGE into the download_statistics table) after core's hook_file_download access checks pass. Files are marked for counting by selecting one of the module's field formatters ('File with Download Statistics recorded' for file fields, 'File URI with Download Count' for the file URI) or by placing the Popular file downloads block. Counts surface through that block (top today, top all-time, most recently downloaded), through Views (Total file downloads, File downloads today, Most recent file download, gated by the 'view file download statistics' permission), and through file tokens (total-count, day-count, last-view, last-user). Counting is toggled and the counts table cleared at /admin/config/system/download-statistics ('administer download statistics'). Hook_cron resets the daily counter every 24 hours and hook_ranking feeds download popularity into core search scoring.
